items.stem: Which CloudWatch feature lets you run ad-hoc queries across log data to investigate an incident?

options.rationale: Correct: Logs Insights runs interactive queries over log groups.
Alarms evaluate thresholds; they do not run log queries.
Widgets visualise data but do not provide ad-hoc log querying.
A namespace is a metric container, not a query tool.

items.explanation: Correct: Logs Insights runs interactive queries over log groups.

items.stem: You want one alarm that only fires when both high latency AND high error rate are true. What do you use?

options.text: A composite alarm combining the two metric alarms
options.rationale: Correct: composite alarms combine multiple alarm states with logic such as AND.
A single metric alarm cannot combine two independent metrics with logic.
Retention controls storage, not alarm logic.
Dashboards visualise but do not alarm.

items.explanation: Correct: composite alarms combine multiple alarm states with logic such as AND.

items.stem: Which TWO actions help control CloudWatch Logs cost? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Set appropriate retention periods on log groups
options.rationale: Correct: retention limits how long logs are stored and billed.

options.text: Filter or sample noisy, low-value logs
options.rationale: Correct: reducing ingested volume lowers cost.

options.text: Keep all logs indefinitely by default
Duplicate every log into three groups
options.rationale: Duplication raises both ingestion and storage cost.

items.explanation: Correct: setting retention and filtering noisy logs both control cost.
